result:
Root cause: `strip_reminders` in `anthrouter/request_text.py` never trimmed whitespace, though its docstring says it does. Removing the `<system-reminder>` block left a leading `\n`, so the `startswith(ACTIVITY_LABEL_PREFIX)` check failed. I changed it to return `.strip()`, so every caller of `strip_reminders` now gets trimmed text.

I checked your example by hand: `is_activity_label_prompt` now returns `True`. I couldn't run the test suite because `pytest` isn't installed here. The other callers (`handlers.py` and `model_router.py`) now receive trimmed text, and I haven't checked whether any existing test depends on the leading or trailing whitespace.
